name: Wikipedia
body: HSTS is preloaded, security.txt is published, and articles read without JavaScript. But the Main Page and the other 18 pages analyzed have no meta description, so search engines pick the snippet.
lesson: Write a description of about 150 characters for each key page, so you choose the pitch, not the crawler.
summary: en.wikipedia.org scores 84 out of 100 (B). 1 check fails now, 15 are at risk, and 19 pass. Fix first: 26 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 26 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /wiki/Main_Page, /wiki/Wikipedia:Contents, /wiki/Portal:Current_events, /wiki/Wikipedia:About and 15 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 92 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 19 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: 19 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /wiki/Main_Page, /wiki/Wikipedia:Contents, /wiki/Portal:Current_events, /wiki/Wikipedia:About and 15 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 19 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 19 pages analyzed.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
The start page arrived in 652 ms
Structured data parses and carries the expected properties
